segment.source: NetworkControl decides which apps may use the network. Here is how it works:
You decide when an app first connects
A prompt shows the app and where it wants to connect. Allow or deny, and choose how long to remember the answer.
The overview shows connection activity over time; the Apps page lists every app that used the network.
Stay in control from the tray
Closing the window keeps protection running. Use the tray icon to switch modes or block all traffic instantly.
You can change the mode at any time on the overview page or from the tray.
The core service is not connected yet; the mode can be chosen later on the overview page.
